entries.name: 雷诺 · 休伯利安
entries.detail: Subject: Jim Raynor from StarCraft II, battle-hardened middle-aged Terran marshal, weathered Caucasian face, short dark brown hair, stubble, strong furrowed brow, determined blue eyes. He wears authentic oversized worn blue CMC marine armor with its helmet OPEN framing his visible face, broad rounded scratched pauldrons, mechanical neck ring and a few tiny amber lamps. Three-quarter portrait angled subtly toward the left, not a full-body soldier. Scene: the shadowed Hyperion hangar and a distant Terran battlecruiser silhouette through blue haze, subtle sparks. Palette: deep navy, gunmetal, cold steel blue with a restrained amber rim light. His face must dominate and feel like a painted SC2 cover.
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one full-bleed illustrated cover background for an unofficial StarCraft II inspired game main menu.
Target dimensions: 2048 x 1152, landscape 16:9. Make a single finished image.
Style/medium: richly painted cinematic sci-fi key art, high-end digital illustration with hand-painted texture and controlled fine detail, solemn grounded StarCraft II atmosphere, believable character anatomy. This is artwork, not a screenshot or a render of a gameplay model.
Composition: one commanding character in a very large head-and-shoulders / upper-torso portrait on the RIGHT. Face centered around 73% of image width and 30% of image height. The upper torso occupies the right half; head is large, readable and expressive. Allow the rightmost 35% to crop into a tall phone view with the face intact. LEFT 43% is quiet, almost-black navy atmospheric negative space for an existing menu. Lower third gently darkens and dissolves into the background for portrait-view buttons. Paint character, light, smoke and distant environment as one cohesive image. Edges of shoulders and armor dissolve gradually into shadow, smoke and space; no outlined cutout, sticker or character standing on a plinth.
Lighting: dramatic directional lighting, dark cinematic values, crisp selective highlights at the face, strong silhouette, restrained bloom, rich depth and atmospheric perspective.
Constraints: no UI, no text, no logo, no letters, no watermark, no borders, no collage, no triptych, no extra foreground character. No generic stock sci-fi soldier, no anime, no cartoon, no toy, no flat black studio product backdrop. Keep the dark menu region unobstructed.

entries.name: 凯瑞甘 · 刀锋女王
entries.detail: Subject: Sarah Kerrigan, StarCraft II Queen of Blades, recognizable fierce human female face with glowing violet eyes, dark organic chitin across her neck and shoulders, swept-back segmented living tendril hair, elegant bone-blade wing roots sweeping upward behind her, brown-violet carapace with luminous violet fissures. Strong face and upper torso, not a full-body nude figure. Scene: distant Zerg hive spires and organic silhouettes immersed in violet nebula, drifting spores and smoke. Palette: near-black indigo, dark umber chitin, violet psionic highlights, subtle cool rim light. Confident predatory expression, regal and terrifying, human face remains clearly readable.

entries.name: 阿塔尼斯 · 达拉姆
entries.detail: Subject: Artanis the StarCraft II Protoss hierarch, unmistakably alien elongated pale blue-gray face, glowing cyan eyes, no human nose or mouth, sculpted high brow and elongated chin, majestic ornate ivory-gold Protoss shoulder armor, gold filigree and blue khaydarin crystal at chest, short severed nerve cords behind his head. Very large noble three-quarter face portrait, not a human in a helmet. Scene: faint Spear of Adun / Protoss fleet arcs and an ancient Aiur skyline through cosmic dust. Palette: midnight blue, antique gold, bone ivory and focused icy cyan psionic light. Restrained ceremonial grandeur and ancient alien gravitas.

entries.name: 诺娃 · 隐秘行动
entries.detail: Subject: Nova Terra, StarCraft II blonde female Ghost operative, pale face, cold focused blue eyes, tied-back long blonde hair with a few wisps, fitted dark charcoal and white-gray Ghost armor with subtle blue luminous conduits, discreet mechanical neck hardware, a sliver of sniper rifle near the lower right. Face and shoulders fill the right part, head turned slightly left in alert concentration. Scene: a distant Terran covert-ops platform and a rainy industrial skyline with faint searchlights and blue mist. Palette: near-black blue, frosty cyan and desaturated platinum blonde, one restrained red far-background light. Realistic mature proportions, tactical and austere, no pinup pose, no decorative fantasy costume.

entries.name: 扎加拉 · 虫群之母
entries.detail: Subject: Zagara the StarCraft II Zerg broodmother, a distinctly non-human monstrous female Zerg queen. Huge layered brown-black chitin crown, spiked elongated crest rising behind her, narrow yellow-amber eyes set into an angular insectoid face, mandible-like jaws, carapace shoulder plates and a few curved scythe limbs at the right edge. Make a large expressive alien face and upper thorax portrait, organic not a humanoid woman or dragon. Scene: shadowed Zerg hatcheries and massed swarm silhouettes receding into purple spores and smoky deep space. Palette: dark violet and umber, muted bone, amber eye glow, restrained magenta bioluminescence. Imposing and ancient, ferocious hive intelligence.

entries.name: 泽拉图 · 虚空之影
entries.detail: Subject: Zeratul, StarCraft II dark templar, unmistakably Protoss alien long angular face beneath a worn dark hood, two bright green eyes, no human nose or mouth, lower face partly covered with a dark fabric mask, elongated chin, dark leather and antique bronze shoulder fittings, severed nerve cords. Large hooded head and shoulders, subtle three-quarter angle, an emerald psi blade's glow touches the lower right edge without crossing the quiet left. Scene: ancient Shakuras stone pillars fading into blue-violet mist and starless void. Palette: near-black navy, smoke violet, restrained green psionic highlights and muted bronze. Ominous contemplative prophetic character, not a human assassin.

entries.name: 泰凯斯 · 钢铁火力
entries.detail: Subject: Tychus Findlay, StarCraft II burly Terran marine, middle-aged heavy square-jawed face, very short hair, rugged stubble, amused defiant squint, small cigar at the corner of his mouth. Massive worn dark blue CMC powered armor, huge rounded shoulder plate and open circular helmet collar with a few tiny orange indicators. Large close portrait cropped at the chest, imposing scale, face fully visible. Scene: a smoky Terran forge hangar with distant steel catwalks and a faint battlecruiser silhouette, very subtle ember flecks. Palette: deep navy and cobalt steel, smoky charcoal, warm orange forge edge light. Painted material wear, confident bruiser attitude, no cartoon muscles.

entries.name: 德哈卡 · 原始进化
entries.detail: Subject: Dehaka, StarCraft II primal Zerg pack leader, massive asymmetric organic predator with recognizable saurian insectoid armored head, jagged layered dark teal/brown chitin, large tusk-like mandibles and teeth, small fierce yellow-green eyes, uneven spiky growths on one shoulder, powerful neck and upper torso. Large monster face on the right, three-quarter portrait turning left, no human face, no generic dinosaur or dragon wings. Scene: distant Zerus primordial jungle silhouettes, ancient roots and living spores merging into cosmic dark fog. Palette: near-black deep violet, desaturated moss and dark umber, restrained acidic green biological light and amber eye glints. Brutal weight and primal alien texture.

entries.name: 菲尼克斯 · 净化者
entries.detail: Subject: Fenix in his StarCraft II Purifier champion form, clearly Protoss-designed mechanical alien warrior, angular ivory and antique-gold armored faceplate shaped around an elongated mouthless alien head, intense blue eye slits, tall segmented crest, blue psionic core, broad ornate geometric shoulder armor with worn etched gold trim. Very large head-and-shoulders portrait, heavy solemn warrior stance. Scene: distant Purifier fleet and Cybros-like luminous orbital rings dissolving into cosmic blue haze. Palette: midnight blue, matte ivory, antique gold and brilliant but restrained cyan core light. Painterly metal and atmospheric edges, elegant ancient alien technology, not a generic human-faced robot or modern superhero.
